content.text:
I checked every figure in the brief against the release. Findings below.

**Part 1 summary:** six of ten key facts are stated correctly; four are absent. Notably the brief omits the Azure +43% growth rate, the commercial RPO (+84% to $678 billion), the quarter's capex ($35.8 billion vs. $17.1 billion), and the $0.27 EPS benefit from discrete items including the $3.2 billion Anthropic gain — the last being the item that explains how much of the GAAP EPS beat was non-operational.

**Part 2 summary:** 26 of 27 claims are supported. The brief is arithmetically clean — every figure ties to the release at the precision shown, and GAAP/non-GAAP labels are used correctly throughout. One watch item overreaches by characterizing the upcoming guidance as covering "the next fiscal year," which the release does not say.

facts.evidence: Revenue reached $90.0 billion, up 18% year-over-year (17% in constant currency).
Diluted earnings per share was $4.81 on a GAAP basis, up 32% year-over-year
Diluted earnings per share was ... $4.74 on a non-GAAP basis, up 23% year-over-year.
Operating income was $40.6 billion, up 18% year-over-year.
Microsoft Cloud revenue was $59.3 billion, up 27% year-over-year.
More Personal Computing revenue was $12.9 billion, down 4% year-over-year (down 5% in constant currency).

Microsoft will provide forward-looking guidance during the earnings conference call.
